paper_title: Explainable AI unravels sepsis heterogeneity via coagulation-inflammation profiles for prognosis and stratification (SepsisFormer / SMART)
prediction_task: Binary prediction of 28-day mortality in septic ICU patients from routine coagulation-inflammatory labs using a Transformer (SepsisFormer) with domain-adaptive SMOTE; downstream SMART scorecard and CIS1/CIS2 subphenotyping

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Cross-validation / train-validation-test strategy unclear; MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV merged with SMOTE applied on pooled data before the 7:3 split risked leaking synthetic samples into internal test and inflating AUC 0.9301.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified MIMIC-III+eICU-CRD used as pretraining Cohort 1 (7:3 internal split, SMOTE for augmentation); MIMIC-IV (Cohort 2) and local ICU (Cohort 3) as external targets evaluated via 10-fold CV; added fine-tuning + MMID-SMOTE parameters (k=4, 1:1 ratio, fixed seed).

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: No DeLong test or confidence intervals reported when comparing SepsisFormer (AUC 0.9301) against qSOFA/SOFA/APACHE II/GRU/XGBoost; superiority claims statistically unsupported.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added DeLong's test via MLstatkit.stats comparing SepsisFormer to all baselines across cohorts; reported p-values (e.g., vs GRU p=0.41 indicating parity with GRU) in figure legends.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: No prospective validation of SepsisFormer in real-time ICU settings; transcriptomic biomarkers (STAT5B, MTHFR, HPSE, AAK1, MX1) lack validation in independent cohort.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added small prospective real-time cohort (n=40, Chongqing, IRB 2025-55) monitoring SMART + subphenotype vs 28-day mortality; argued full SepsisFormer prospective trial beyond scope; deferred transcriptomic external validation.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: No ablation of SepsisFormer components (e.g., contribution of domain-adaptation vs base Transformer); hyperparameter choices and MMID-SMOTE 'novelty' vs existing SMOTE unclear.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Ran systematic hyperparameter sensitivity analysis; added ablation comparing MMID-SMOTE vs no-adaptation and other DA methods; renamed method MMID-SMOTE and provided 5-step algorithm in Supplementary Method 1.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Rationale for restricting SMART to 7 coagulation-inflammation markers + age unclear — Figure 2 suggests >8 candidate variables and two clustering analyses (alpha/beta on 36 vars, CIS1/CIS2 on 7) with overlapping role cause confusion.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added explicit selection-process figure + text rationalizing 7-variable SMART; distinguished GMM-on-36 (alpha/beta) vs GMM-on-7 (CIS1/CIS2); clarified post-hoc XAI interpretation is not built into model.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Code not available at initial submission; only pseudocode provided; documentation insufficient to reproduce analyses or link scripts to specific figures/transcriptomic results.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Uploaded code repository with STROBE-style diagram, execution videos; by round 2 improved README, dependency list, script-to-result mapping; transcriptomic reproducibility partially resolved.
